"The task before us is no less than when our mothers undertook it," Kisada said. "If we are to succeed, we must put deceit behind us."
Nitoshi nodded. "To you and you alone, my friend, I shall never lie."

"Spies, infiltrators, even the most trusted men can turn against you," cursed the Daidoji general. "Yes, my lord. Trust no one." With that and a twist of his blade, Osen vanished, and the Sword of the Lion was forever free from the hands of the Crane.
"What is this?" the magistrate demanded. "These papers are forgeries!" The shugenja smiled and reached for a scroll. "I know."
"I know not why the Scorpion have made us their enemies. I only know that they shall regret it." - Hiruma Todori
"A knife in the back is so passe and unfashionable. A few words and the right seal on a scroll can accomplish so much more without all the drama and fanfare." - Bayushi Nitoshi
